title: The True Minecraft
description: Mixing the Minecraft Games into one
body:
### Taking all the minecraft's and squishing them into one wibbly wobbly ball of stuff.


A focus on improving Combat and leveling is a heavy focus of this pack along with giving plays items and blocks to match those found in Dungeons and Legends.

Quality of life features are also found including preformance improvemnts and crop replanting.
